name: VideoMAE V2 (OpenGVLab; dual-masking video masked autoencoder, ViT-B/L/H/g pre-trained on UnlabeledHybrid)
version: Primary: HF OpenGVLab/VideoMAEv2-giant (ViT-g/14, 1,011M params, UnlabeledHybrid 1200 epochs, encoder only, feature extraction; repo sha d27568eb41ccb2d41bb191fc2e3fe5aad74942d4, 2025-01-14). Same series: OpenGVLab/VideoMAEv2-Base (800 ep), -Large (800 ep), -Huge (1200 ep), and the full pretrain checkpoint mae-g/vit_g_hybrid_pt_1200e.pth in OpenGVLab/VideoMAE2. NOT in scope of this entry: the K710 fine-tuned ViT-g checkpoints and the distilled ViT-S/ViT-B (vit_*_k710_dl_from_giant.pth: supervised distillation from the K710-fine-tuned teacher, not masked-autoencoder pretraining).

paper.title: VideoMAE V2: Scaling Video Masked Autoencoders with Dual Masking
paper.note: the HF VideoMAEv2-* cards link the paper title to arXiv 2203.12602 (VideoMAE v1) -- a card mislink; the BibTeX in the same cards gives eprint 2303.16727

weights_location.verified_how: HF API model listings (metadata only) saved as videomaev2_OpenGVLab__VideoMAEv2-giant_hfapi.json, videomaev2_OpenGVLab__VideoMAEv2-Huge_hfapi.json, videomaev2_OpenGVLab__VideoMAEv2-Large_hfapi.json, videomaev2_OpenGVLab__VideoMAEv2-Base_hfapi.json, videomaev2_OpenGVLab__VideoMAE2_hfapi.json; nothing downloaded
weights_location.note: The GitHub MODEL_ZOO directs users to a Google 'VideoMAE V2 Download Request Form' for the ViT-g weights; the same official organisation (OpenGVLab) also lists the pretrain weights publicly and ungated on HF, which is what C1 is judged on.

quotes.quote: Please fill out [VideoMAE V2 Download Request Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd1SjKMtD8piL9uxGEUwicerxd46bs12QojQt92rzalnoI3JA/viewform?usp=sf_link), **you will see the download link** for the VideoMAE V2 model weights after submission.

licence.id: CC-BY-NC-4.0 (HF VideoMAEv2-* cards); GitHub repo LICENSE = MIT; HF OpenGVLab/VideoMAE2 card = apache-2.0 (inconsistent tags; the most restrictive, CC-BY-NC-4.0, is assumed for the VideoMAEv2-* weights)
licence.commercial: not permitted under CC-BY-NC-4.0 (the MIT/Apache tags would permit it; unresolved inconsistency)
licence.gating: none at HF level (GitHub route uses a request form)

domain.value: masked video autoencoder (VideoMAE with dual masking: encoder tube masking 90% + decoder running-cell masking; MSE reconstruction of masked pixel cubes), self-supervised on a 1.35M-clip general-video mix (UnlabeledHybrid)

quotes.quote: we propose to mask the decoder as well and devise the dual masking strategy.
VideoMAE v2 does not reconstruct the full video clip, while only calculates MSE loss on tokens that are invisible to the encoder.
You can use the raw model for video feature extraction.
VideoMAEv2-giant model pre-trained for 1200 epochs in a self-supervised way on UnlabeldHybrid-1M dataset.

architecture.type: vanilla ViT (joint space-time attention) on 2x14x14 (ViT-g) or 2x16x16 (B/L/H) cube tokens; 4-block 512-dim decoder used only in pretraining (HF VideoMAEv2-* repos are encoder-only)
architecture.representation: encoder output tokens (1408-dim for ViT-g; 1280 H, 1024 L, 768 B) or a pooled vector of the same dimension

pretraining_data.summary: UnlabeledHybrid, ~1.35M clips: K710 (658k, YouTube; union of K400/600/700), SSv2 (169k, shot from scripts), AVA (21k, movies), WebVid2M subset (250k, 'scraped from the internet'), self-collected Instagram (250k, 'uncurated videos crawled from Instagram'). Named sources; the Instagram part is a non-public self-crawl.
pretraining_data.form: dataset/source list (named, includes open-ended web/Instagram sources)

quotes.quote: Specifically, our dataset is built by simply selecting videos from the public available datasets of Kinetics [43], Something-Something [31], AVA [32], WebVid2M [5], and our own crawled Instagram dataset.

medical_video_in_data.basis: Term search of the cards, paper and GitHub data docs found no medical/surgical term; WebVid2M and the self-crawled Instagram clips are open-ended web content whose categories are not documented.

appendix300_possible.basis: Besides closed benchmarks (Kinetics, SSv2, AVA), UnlabeledHybrid contains WebVid2M (internet stock footage) and 250k 'uncurated videos crawled from Instagram': named but open-ended sources, so the documentation does not allow the Appendix300 source recordings to be excluded. frame_rate_or_sampling.value: 16 frames with sampling interval 2 for SSv2 videos and 4 for the other UnlabeledHybrid sources (source fps not fixed)

quotes.quote: We set **different sampling intervals** for the videos from different sources in unlabeledhybrid: 2 for SSv2 and 4 for the other datasets.

spatial_compression.value: 14x14 patches for ViT-g (224 -> 16x16 = 256 tokens per slice); 16x16 patches for ViT-B/L/H (224 -> 14x14 = 196)

embedding_dim.value: ViT-g: 1408 x (8 x 16 x 16) = 1408 x 2048 tokens per 16-frame 224x224 clip; pooled 1408. ViT-H 1280 x 1568; ViT-L 1024 x 1568; ViT-B 768 x 1568 (pooled = embed_dim; VideoMAEv2-Base config use_mean_pooling true)
embedding_dim.derivation: embed_dim from HF configs; Table 7 cube output 1408 x 8 x 256 for ViT-g

params.value: ViT-g 1,011M (paper); ViT-B/L/H backbones = VideoMAE v1 architectures (87M / 305M / 633M per VideoMAE paper Table 7, incl. task head); HF VideoMAEv2-giant model.safetensors 4.105 GB fp32 ~ 1.03B (inferred, consistent)
